limitations: Categorical inspection priority; no calibrated flood probability, depth, return period or damage.

Daily totals do not establish short-duration intensity or sewer capacity exceedance.
Cadastral cell intersection is potential exposure, not whole-cell imperviousness or exposed building area.
No current, asset-located blockage survey or hydraulic pipe network is available.
